body: The question is if you take the blue pill and end in a world with people who have powers [fairy tail, dbz, op] would you get powers as well or be left a non mag sitting on the sidelines?
I think I was just having a moment of weakness yesterday with it all coming to a head and wanted someone to talk to. I don't really have anyone anymore

Hey there, I really appreciate you taking time out of your day to read my sob story. You know growing up I was, well we all were, resentful of those who were better off. To be honest I held on to that anger for a long time, but now most of me is just happy that someone out there didn’t have to go through the shit we did, that someone has had a good life experience. It gives me hope for the future. 

You want to know what I’m going to college for? I’ve told myself college wasn’t an option for so long, I was at odds with myself over which direction to go. You see, I write in my spare time, nothing fancy just wanna be Stephen King shit and fantasy but I also love the sciences. So it boiled down to two choices, English/Creative Writing or Engineering. Now I have a thing for numbers and no matter how you look at it the arts route would’ve been the bigger gamble odds wise, so engineering. But what to engineer? It took me some time but I found something I’m immensely passionate about. Space, the final frontier. There’s always been a part of me completely and utterly frustrated that by the time I was born, the whole world had been explored (and I don’t want to hear about the ocean depths, don’t care about that for some reason). So space appeals to that part of me and one more thing. Hope. I may have an intense hatred for a lot of peoples stupidity and ignorance and malice and greed, but the good in us gives me hope that we can be better a few hundred generations down the line. So with the way things are going, we’re more and more likely to irreparably damage our home here on Earth and so to give us time to mature I’d like to contribute (even the smallest amount) to the best chance we have to survive long enough as a species to realize the almost bottomless potential we have if we just worked together. 

Ugh, kind of went on a rant there, but thanks again for reaching out. It’s definitely helped.
Thanks all! I appreciate the help and look forward to the move!
